proposed.explanation: We cannot recommend buying or determine if the share is cheap because the primary financial figures for revenue and net profit are marked AMBIGUOUS due to conflicting unit indicators on page 2 of the report. Furthermore, calculating a reliable full-year 2026 earnings per share and price-to-earnings ratio requires unambiguous income statement data or full-year projections rather than simply annualizing nine-month figures without clear metrics. Therefore, evidence is insufficient to make a responsible decision.
limitations: Revenue and net profit figures are ambiguous due to conflicting unit labels in the source report.
Nine-month results are insufficient to accurately project full-year performance without additional guidance.
